messages:
ellen: Heads-up from CSM: HelioQ reported an unexpected reserved-capacity overage on INV-2026-0912. They say we charged a burst line even though they had reserved headroom in another AZ.
ravi: can you paste the invoice lines and the meter export pointer?
elllen: pasted below (trimmed):
```
line_id,nodepool,az,period_start,period_end,gpu_hours,unit_price
INV-L-55612,np-az1,eu-west-1a,2026-05-19T02:00Z,2026-05-19T03:00Z,12.0,2.40
INV-L-55613,np-az2-standby,eu-west-1b,2026-05-19T02:00Z,2026-05-19T03:00Z,0.0,0.00
INV-L-55614,burst-overage,eu-west-1a,2026-05-19T02:10Z,2026-05-19T02:40Z,2.0,3.75
```
ops-bot: Meter export uploaded: s3://meter-exports/helioq/2026-05/20260519.csv sha1: b7c9f.
tom: quick summary from infra: autoscaler routed traffic into az1 after a transient network flap. Reserved pool existed in az2 but cross-AZ failover takes time; our routing policy doesn't automatically borrow reserved capacity across AZs. The burst lines are real usage, not double-billing.
jess: policy check  do we offer cross-AZ reserved pooling? I thought some customers opt into that.
ravi: HelioQ's contract: reserved commits are zonal by default unless they purchased regional pooling. They didn't. So technically the burst is valid. That said, customer thought "reserved headroom" would be globally applied.
elllen: customer is upset because they expected smoother failover without burst fees. They asked for a one-time credit and a note on how to avoid it in future.
tom: recommend two actions: 1) clear explanation + offer a one-time goodwill credit equivalent to overage charge ($7.50) as customer success concession, 2) propose upsell: regional pooling add-on or failover policy configuration to avoid cross-AZ bursts.
jess: finance: GL code and approval flow?
finance-bot: For goodwill credits under $100, sales ops approval not required; book under CUSTOMER_GOODWILL_CREDITS. Please attach CSM signoff.
ravi: propose issuing CR-2026-411 for $7.50 against INV-2026-0912 and document as "goodwill credit for cross-AZ burst charges; customer education + configuration offer". Approve?
elllen: approve. I'll send the note: "we're issuing a one-time credit and recommending regional pooling to avoid repeats."
tom: ops: can we offer a quick config change to their dedicated pool (enable regional pooling) as a trial?
ops-bot: We can enable a 7-day trial of regional pooling on their dedicated capacity; will require an ops ticket and capacity planning check.
jess: also suggest we add clearer language to the billing FAQ: "reserved commits are zonal unless regional pooling purchased" and an in-console prompt when creating reserves.
ravi: credit created: CR-2026-411 for $7.50 applied to INV-2026-0912. FIN ticket FIN-2026-415 opened to track upsell + trial enablement.
elllen: note to include in customer reply: how to avoid (regional pooling) + link to docs + offer trial. I'll send and CC finance.
jess: filing a doc update request for billing FAQ and console copy. Marking as P1 for doc triage.
ravi: closing notes: credit applied as goodwill, customer trial offer in-flight, policy unchanged (zonal by default). Leaving this thread open until trial is scheduled.
elllen: customer accepted the credit and said they'd evaluate regional pooling. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
